Author: Tataru-business
Name: Keybound Automation
Description: Reads Keybound Brawler prompts and answers with keyboard input. Open /tatarubrawler for the Cyberpunk interface. Auto queue on lobby entry repeats until Stop auto queue; the circular arrows start a counted manual loop. Diagnostic recording, automatic play, and play on MapID 1359 are enabled at startup.
Punchline: Automatically type Keybound Brawler prompts and optionally keep queueing.
